title: afl common step
description: A step written once that workflows reuse with "use": "<id>", filling its {{params.<id>}} with "with" and overriding any of its fields. Lives in workflows/steps (built-in), ~/.afl/steps or <repo>/.afl/steps.

$schema.description: This schema, for editors. afl ignores it.

id.description: Used in "use" and as the file name; overrides a built-in or global common step with the same id.

description.description: What the step does and when to use it.

tags.description: Tags to filter the library by in the UI and with --tag, e.g. review or planning: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

parameters.description: Values a using step gives in "with", written {{params.<id>}} anywhere in the step.

step.description: The step itself; its id and name are what a using step's default to. It can't itself use or include.
